    Cryptographic Credential Chamber

    Password Manager

    Client-side AES-GCM encrypted credential storage powered by your browser's Web Crypto API.

    Auto-lock: 5:00

    Initialize Your Password Manager

    Establish a strong Master Password. It derives a 256-bit AES-GCM key locally via PBKDF2-SHA256 (310,000 iterations).

    Password Manager Is Sealed

    Enter your Master Password to decrypt your local credentials in memory.

    Irrecoverable Master Password Warning: Your master password is never saved anywhere. If you forget it, your encrypted vault entries cannot be decrypted or recovered.

    Honest Security & Browser Storage Notice: Entries are encrypted in your browser using Web Crypto (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM) and stored in local IndexedDB. Clearing browser site data will delete local storage. This personal browser tool has not undergone an external commercial security audit.
